{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of Nigeria|Cuisine of Nigeria]] 

'''Chapman''' is a sweet non-alcoholic drink widely served at parties and events all across the Nigeria.

== Ingredients ==
*2 bottles (6 liters) Boom blackcurrant beverage
*[[Cookbook:Water|Water]]
*5 [[Cookbook:Pineapple|pineapple]]s, peeled, cored, and [[Cookbook:Dice|diced]]
*12 [[Cookbook:Apple|apple]]s, cored and diced
*10 [[Cookbook:Watermelon|watermelon]]s, removed from the rind and diced

== Equipment ==
*Large [[Cookbook: Mixing Bowl|mixing bowl]] or punch bowl
*[[Cookbook: Cooking Spoon|Mixing spoon]]
*[[Cookbook:Ladle|Ladle]]
*[[Cookbook:Cutting Board|Cutting board]]
*Large [[Cookbook:Knife|knife]]

== Procedure ==

# Pour the blackcurrant beverage into the bowl. While stirring, dilute with water until it reaches your desired flavor.
# If not sufficiently chilled, transfer to the fridge and rest until cold.
# Divide the diced fruits between serving cups, then fill the cups with the beverage and serve.
